title: Wnt activity defines colon cancer stem cells and is regulated by the microenvironment
central_claims: High Wnt activity identifies colon cancer stem-like cells with greater clonogenic and tumor-initiating potential.
Myofibroblast-secreted HGF can restore stem-like properties to low-Wnt cells.

source_manifest.title: Replication Study: Wnt activity defines colon cancer stem cells and is regulated by the microenvironment
source_manifest.finding: Higher clonogenicity and stromal/HGF effects generally agreed; marker correlations varied and high/low-Wnt tumorigenicity did not differ.

source_manifest.title: LIG4 mediates Wnt signalling-induced radioresistance
source_manifest.finding: Independent CRC study linked Wnt-high cells to radioresistance and LIG4-dependent DNA repair.
